10 Best Baby Clothes Stores Online

Babies, is there anything we wouldn’t do for them? They are so cute and cuddly, it’s only natural to want to dress them in clothes that make these qualities shine. Fortunately, there is no shortage of adorable baby clothes, and today, you can find everything you need online.

When you shop at baby stores online, you can find an even bigger selection than you would in a standard store. In fact, you’re not limited to only one store, or only the stores that are close by. When you shop online, you can pick and choose your favorite baby clothes from different sites and not be limited by location. Plus, baby clothing websites often have sales and specials that retail stores don’t.

Perhaps the only drawback of ordering online is that in some cases, you have to pay a shipping fee. However, when you take into account the time and headache you save by ordering online instead of having to go to the mall or local baby store, the shipping fee can be well worth the cost. Additionally, many sites offer free shipping for a specified minimum order, and sites like The Children’s Place offer free shipping on everything.

Many of the best baby clothing sites also offer free returns within a certain number of days (for example, Gap has a 45-day return policy while Walmart has a 90-day policy). If you’re concerned that you may need to return your items, make sure to read the site’s policy before ordering.

The Best Baby Clothes Sites

Here, we’ve rounded up the best baby clothes websites so that you can have an easier time finding clothes for your little one.

Whether you’re looking for cuteness, comfort, quality fabrics, trendy styles, or great deals, these top 10 baby clothing sites have got you covered:

1. Amazon

While not strictly a baby clothing website, Amazon has one of the most diverse selections of baby clothes you can find. From basic onesies to the most elaborate flower girl dresses and everything in between, the only issue you might have with Amazon is narrowing down your choices. To help you out, you can search by brand, size, color, etc. and read real user reviews.

And of course, nothing beats free next-day shipping with Prime.

2. Gap

The only thing better than finding your favorite baby styles at the Gap is finding them online. Gap clothes are typically basic but have these little extra details that set them apart from other best baby clothing brands. In the baby department, trendiness is combined with comfort so that your littles ones can look fashionable but still move around. Expect to see lots of onesies, outfits, and denim. Lots of denim. Make sure to check out the sale section, where you can find good deals and stock up for the next season.

3. Old Navy

Old Navy is Gap’s more affordable sister brand, so it’s no surprise that it ranks as one of the best baby clothing websites. Old Navy has a fairly large selection of baby clothes, whether you’re looking for solid bodysuits or more trendy jumpsuits or jeans. Parents like Old Navy clothes because they’re good for everyday use but they’re not so basic that they’re boring. Of course, the frequent sales and generally low prices also make Old Navy a family favorite.

4. Carter’s

Carter’s has been around for over 100 years, so it’s no wonder that it has developed a reputation as the go-to brand for baby apparel. With Carter’s, the name of the game is comfort and quality. Clothes are designed to feel good against your baby’s skin and last after multiple washes. Carter’s clothes typically have bright colors and fun patterns, but perhaps more importantly, they are designed practically, making it easy to get off and on without a struggle. Carter’s also has great sales that can be worth waiting for.

5. The Children’s Place

Cuteness and comfort are intertwined at The Children’s Place, which has been around for over 50 years. The Children’s Place baby line offers fun patterns, beautiful dresses, cozy outerwear, and fashionable accessories. If your baby has older siblings, you can often find matching clothes in larger sizes. In terms of cost, The Children’s Place is fairly affordable, but its sales are downright unbelievable. You can easily get $5 deals on shirts, onesies, dresses, and more, plus, shipping is always free.

6. Hanna Andersson

The Swedish-born Gun Denhart launched her brand of children’s clothes, Hanna Andersson, in the 80s from Portland, Oregon. Today, the brand is known around the world for its high-quality, soft fabric that’s made to last, and it’s simple, bright colors that delight and inspire. While not cheap, parents who buy Hanna Andersson clothing know that they are buying something that can be passed on from one child to the next, without losing any of its brightness or comfort. For a real treat, check out the brand’s Matching Family pajamas. The cuteness is unparalleled.

7. Walmart

Like Amazon, you can get just about anything at Walmart, but its collection of baby clothes bears special note because it’s one of the best sites to find cheap baby clothes online. You’d be hard-pressed to find lower prices than Walmart, especially for sale items. You can search for baby clothes by type, brand, size, color, and price. Outfit sets, tops, bodysuits, pajamas, dresses, bathing suits, tights, underwear, hats, mittens, and bibs, you can find everything you need for your baby (and children, and entire family) at one convenient site.

8. Primary

You can tell what kind of baby clothes are sold at Primary just from its name: bright, bold basics that never go out of style. The site was created by 2 moms who were always on the lookout for solid baby basics at affordable prices, and since they couldn’t find a go-to store, they created their own. Primary clothes are made from soft, sturdy fabric and its line of basics doesn’t cost more than $25. You can search the site by age, category, even by color. If you’re looking for rainbow patterns, that’s one of Primary’s specialties.

9. Mini Boden USA

Mini Boden is a British baby clothing website that expanded to the USA in 2002. When you browse through the site, you may feel as if you’re in a little baby boutique online—the clothes are that special. Somehow, the collection looks both old-fashioned and completely modern at the same time, making for very unique apparel. Parents who dress their kids in Mini Boden are sure to get lots of compliments. The only caveat is, this high level of cuteness comes at a fairly lofty price. If you're on a budget, consider a cheaper clothes store for your baby clothes.

10. Tea Collection

Tea Collection is a baby clothing brand with a larger purpose. The company values respect for all cultures, and they show it through their globally-inspired patterns and prints. Tea Collection follows ethical sourcing practices and donates 10% of its profits to the Global Fund for Children and other non-profits. As for its baby clothes, they are sweet with gentle colors, made from high-quality fabric that is designed to last from one child to the next.

You Can’t Go Wrong When Shopping Baby Clothes Online

When shopping for clothes for your little one, there aren’t many mistakes you can make. Whatever items you choose, your baby’s smiling face will be what people notice first. Of course, if they’re wearing something precious and adorable, it won’t hurt. But here, it’s a matter of your personal preference. What’s important to you? Basics that are easy to get on and off, trendsetting apparel, eco-friendly companies, or low prices? Since there are so many high-quality clothes stores, you get to make the call based on what you want.
